name: settings_set_brightness
intent: Set the device brightness to maximum in Settings
description: Opens Settings, navigates to Display and Brightness level, then drags the brightness slider all the way to the right until it reaches the maximum value.
patterns: make the screen as bright as possible

steps.intent: Scroll until the Display settings item is visible
Tap the Brightness level setting to open the brightness slider
Swipe the brightness slider to the maximum
Swipe the brightness slider again to ensure it reaches full maximum
